title: A tampered approval gives controller/approval_invalid and stops the drain

steps.sh: git clone -q "$ORIGIN" "$CASE_DIR/tamper" && cd "$CASE_DIR/tamper" && git fetch -q origin refs/kogen/intents/greet && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && sed 's/"by":"[^"]*"/"by":"Mallory <m@example.invalid>"/' .kogen/intents/greet/approval.json > a.tmp && mv a.tmp .kogen/intents/greet/approval.json && git commit -q -a -m "$(git log -1 --format=%B)" && git push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/kogen/intents/greet

stdout_regex: (?m)^queue: stopped because greet hit a controller error; 1 Build\(s\), 0 landed, 1 not$
